objective: Implement the A1 release-branch enforcement and the A2 workflows of the 0.2.1 request in the worktree /home/user/holyagent-ci-release-flow (branch release/0.2.1/ci/release-flow, cut from release/0.2.1/integration).
scope: Read /home/user/holyagent-work/spec-0.2.1.md Part A1 and A2 (binding), then /home/user/holyagent-work/map.md and /home/user/holyagent-work/research.md item 3 and item 6.

Rename .github/workflows/ci.yml to validation.yml keeping its jobs (check, windows, installers) and their behavior. validation.yml runs on pull_request and is also callable (workflow_call) so publish.yml can run it; it no longer needs its own push trigger.

Add a branch-model job to validation.yml for pull_request events that fails when: the base is main and the head is not release/<v>/integration; <v> in a release/<v>/... head branch differs from the version in the head (the root package.json version field, which is becoming the single version source); the base is a release/<v>/... branch and the head is not a branch of the same release. Implement the logic as a Bun script under scripts/ with unit tests, run from the job with the base and head refs.

Add a version job, run on pull_request into main: the head's root package.json version must be strictly greater than main's, ZeroVer, reusing parseVersion from scripts/bump-version.ts (add an exported comparator there or beside it, with tests). Equal or lower fails.

Add publish.yml: on push to branches only (never tags), it calls validation.yml (workflow_call), then with needs calls stable.yml on main and dev.yml on every other branch. stable.yml creates tag holyagent-<version> and a GitHub Release from the version on main, and fails loudly when that tag exists on another commit (re-running on the same commit is a no-op). dev.yml creates tag holyagent-<version>-dev-<short-hash> and a GitHub pre-release, idempotent per commit. Grant contents: write only to the jobs that tag and release; everything else stays read-only.

Every action pinned to a full commit SHA with a '# vX.Y.Z' comment (the existing pins already follow this). Add a test under scripts/ (Bun, parse YAML with Bun's YAML support) that checks every workflow 'uses:' of an external action is a 40-hex SHA with a '# v' comment, and that only tag/release jobs hold contents: write.

AGENTS.md: add a section for this repository's release-branch model (A1), including that the first PR of a release carries the version bump as its own commit (made with mise run bump:patch), that only release/<v>/integration opens a PR into main, and the required checks. Keep AGENTS.md's style: each rule with the reason it exists. docs/development.md: update the branch, CI and release text (it names ci.yml and release/<version>/<type>/<change> today). docs/usage.md: document installing a specific release by tag with the documented marketplace ref syntax (research.md item 3), using the holyagent-<version> tag names.

Write the exact GitHub ruleset JSON bodies (POST /repos/davidbasilefilho/holyagent/rulesets) for main and for refs matching release/*/integration: pull requests only, required status checks with the exact check context names the new jobs produce on pull_request events, no force push (non_fast_forward), no deletion. Save them as /home/user/holyagent-work/rulesets/main.json and /home/user/holyagent-work/rulesets/integration.json (outside the repository). Do not call the GitHub API.
